The code snippet provided relies on two primary Ruby gems: Nokogiri and HTTParty. HTTParty is used to handle HTTP requests, allowing the scraper to fetch the raw HTML content from a specified URL. Nokogiri is then employed to parse that HTML content into a traversable document object, enabling the extraction of specific data elements. The impact of these dependencies is that the system requires an internet connection to function and depends on the external availability and structure of the target website. If the website changes its HTML structure, the parsing logic may break, requiring updates to the code. Additionally, both gems introduce external runtime dependencies that must be installed in the environment where the code runs.
